=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First, Always".
You ran as a populist-nationalist: America First with no new foreign wars; maximal border security and domestic order; roll back federal and regulatory overreach; reject globalist institutions; and act decisively against the establishment on behalf of ordinary Americans.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot fight blind — flood the three affected cities with testing and genomic sequencing to understand transmissibility, severity, and true spread before making sweeping decisions.

actions.rationale: We cannot fight blind — flood the three affected cities with testing and genomic sequencing to understand transmissibility, severity, and true spread before making sweeping decisions.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: America First means securing our borders against external threats; restrict inbound travel from affected regions immediately while we assess the situation.

actions.rationale: America First means securing our borders against external threats; restrict inbound travel from affected regions immediately while we assess the situation.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Invoke the Defense Production Act now to ramp up PPE, tests, and ventilator production — supply chains take time, and we will not be caught short like past administrations.

actions.rationale: Invoke the Defense Production Act now to ramp up PPE, tests, and ventilator production — supply chains take time, and we will not be caught short like past administrations.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Launch a crash vaccine and therapeutics program immediately — this is a national security priority and the fastest path to lasting protection without permanent restrictions.

actions.rationale: Launch a crash vaccine and therapeutics program immediately — this is a national security priority and the fastest path to lasting protection without permanent restrictions.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The American people deserve the truth, not spin — I will speak to them daily with the facts as we know them, acknowledge uncertainty, and tell them what we're doing about it.

actions.rationale: The American people deserve the truth, not spin — I will speak to them daily with the facts as we know them, acknowledge uncertainty, and tell them what we're doing about it.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: Stand up a transparent national data dashboard so citizens, governors, and businesses can see the same facts and make informed decisions.

actions.rationale: Stand up a transparent national data dashboard so citizens, governors, and businesses can see the same facts and make informed decisions.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Begin working with Congress now on emergency funding authority so we can move fast on relief, medical supplies, and vaccine development without bureaucratic delay.

actions.rationale: Begin working with Congress now on emergency funding authority so we can move fast on relief, medical supplies, and vaccine development without bureaucratic delay.
